svg.title: Why decimation needs an anti-aliasing filter
svg.desc: Left: a slow wave with a fast ripple, sampled once a second without filtering; the samples trace a false slow wave with the wrong height and timing. Right: the same signal low-pass filtered first, which removes the ripple; the samples follow the real slow wave.
svg.text: 1. Keep every nth sample, no filter
Samples trace a false, shifted wave
Grey: original signal. Dots: the samples kept.
2. Low-pass filter first, then keep every nth
Samples follow the real slow wave
Green: the signal after filtering. Dots: samples kept.
